context:
Goal: no fixed 24-hour limit on how long a lift of the spending cap may last.
Problem (money): a write that only sets the lift's end time in the local settings file never asks you today, so without the 24-hour limit Claude could set a far-off end time you never see.
Based on (ruling): R12, no arbitrary fixed lengths.
Departs from: main undoes an end time more than 24 hours ahead — the write asks you and shows its end time.

options.gain: You see and approve every end time, with no made-up limit.
options.how: Setting the end time joins the ask you already get for a cap lift, and the ask shows the end in Central time; any length is allowed once you say yes.
options.label: Ask you, any length (Recommended)
options.lose: One more yes from you when a lift's end time is set.

options.how: Keep the 24-hour limit until the R12 grant route is built.
options.label: Keep 24 hours for now
options.lose: The fixed number stays a while longer.

options.gain: A hard ceiling on any lift.
options.how: Keep the 24-hour limit for good, as your ruling.
options.label: Keep 24 hours as your ruling
options.lose: A fixed number stays, against R12.

ref: coordinator 12:51 CST Nov 12, from lane fixed-number-limits-census
reply: Filed: setting a cap lift's end time joins the ask you already get, shows the end in Central time, any length. Lane fixed-number-limits-census builds it.
short: Cap-lift end time: ask, not 24 h
title: A spending-cap lift's end time asks you instead of a 24-hour limit
why: It touches spending, so it needs your word.
